title: Lake Tahoe Balloons
specs: Only hot air balloon operation launching and landing on a boat
Flights start at 6,220 feet elevation, can reach up to 10,000 feet
Gentle landings on the Tahoe Flyer boat

No canes, crutches, oxygen tanks in basket
No four-legged family members or service animals allowed on the boat
Largest balloon carries up to 12 passengers
